purpose: Describe an exercise precisely enough for Motion Lab to generate a Coach Avatar draft without hard-coding an animation clip.

fieldGuide.startState: Body configuration before entering the pose.
fieldGuide.targetShape: The final whole-body shape the generator must reach.
fieldGuide.segmentRelationships: Relationships between body segments; prefer semantic relationships over rig-specific Euler angles.
fieldGuide.supports: Feet, hands, knees, pelvis, back or other contact points that must remain anchored.
fieldGuide.trajectory: How major joints/body segments travel from start to target.
fieldGuide.orientation: Palms, toes, head/gaze, torso and limb-facing requirements.
fieldGuide.timing: Entry duration, hold, exit duration and repetitions.
fieldGuide.transitionIn: Ordered phase intent for entering the target shape.
fieldGuide.transitionOut: Ordered phase intent for returning or continuing.
fieldGuide.visualAcceptance: Human checkpoints that must pass before the motion is canonical.
fieldGuide.movementClassification: Optional machine-readable movement family. Classify support pattern, lower-body pattern, trunk pattern, arm-path pattern, and head/gaze pattern so multiple exercises can reuse the same movement logic.
fieldGuide.directionalRules: Optional machine-readable direction contract. State how major segments should travel in body-relative language and explicitly list prohibited trajectories such as an arm sweeping behind the torso when the intended path is forward or lateral.

classificationRule: Classifications describe reusable movement mechanics, not pose names. Examples: stationary-lunge lower body, opposed lateral arm reach, forward four-point support line, prone spinal extension, or rib-side press. Do not encode avatar-specific Euler rotations in descriptions.
generationRule: Description semantics are authoritative. Target-rig bone names, rest pose, local axes, IK, contact solving and interpolation are Motion Lab responsibilities. Generated drafts remain development-only until visual acceptance.
